mapper.insert: MERGE INTO RECIPE_EVALUATIONS target USING (SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID, #{recipeId} AS RECIPE_ID FROM DUAL) src ON (target.USER_ID = src.USER_ID AND target.RECIPE_ID = src.RECIPE_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.RATING = #{rating}, target.FEEDBACK_NOTE = #{feedbackNote}, target.EVALUATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (USER_ID, RECIPE_ID, RATING, FEEDBACK_NOTE, EVALUATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{recipeId}, #{rating}, #{feedbackNote}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT e.EVAL_ID, e.USER_ID, e.RECIPE_ID, e.RATING, e.FEEDBACK_NOTE, e.EVALUATED_AT, u.NICKNAME AS USER_NICKNAME FROM RECIPE_EVALUATIONS e JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE e.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} ORDER BY e.EVALUATED_AT DESC
SELECT RECIPE_ID, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 2) AS AVG_RATING, COUNT(*) AS EVAL_COUNT FROM RECIPE_EVALUATIONS GROUP BY RECIPE_ID
